item.title: From Petit disappointment to Daytona joy: Andlauer's redemption arc is complete, but there's more to come
item.description: After missing out on last year's Petit Le Mans with injury, Julien Andlauer kicked off his first full IMSA season with victory at Daytona. Now Sebring lies in wait.

item.title: New year, same Palou perfection at St. Petersburg
item.description: It was the first race of the 2026 IndyCar season but it felt like a continuation of the last championship run as Chip Ganassi Racing’s Alex Palou converted a fourth-place start into another emphatic victory to launch his quest for a fifth IndyCar crown.
